Select molecule ChEMBL ID as compound_chembl_id, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, standard type, standard relation, standard value, standard units, activity comment, target ChEMBL ID, target name, and target organism. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records, then docs, then activities, then assays, then target_dictionary. Join compound_structures to molecule_dictionary to obtain canonical SMILES. Filter for human Pim-1 kinase by target name. Filter for IC50 standard type. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
